name: Sumisora Tsubasa
source:
She was scouted when she was still a high school student and got a job at GANDARA MUSIC, a major record company. She has a deep love for music and is extraordinarily sensitive. 

She is working hard to produce music as B-PROJECT's A&R.

[Translated from [url=http://www.bprogame.com/member/others/#sumisoratsubasa]official website[/url]]
